description: Thread text frames so a story flows through them, unthread a frame from the next or previous one, flow overset text into new frames on the following pages (adding pages if asked), list a thread, or go to the next, previous, first or last frame in a thread

addPages.description: flow: add pages at the end of the document when the text runs past the last page

frameIds.description: thread: frames in reading order (at least two). Other actions: the frame to act on (the first id)

side.description: unthread: break the thread after the frame (default) or before it

which.description: select: the frame to go to, relative to frameIds[0]

name: thread_text_frames
title: Thread Text Frames
